observations.description: Wide shot of a football match showing a goal being scored by the team in red jerseys. The scoreboard reads 1-1 at 45:08. A player in red celebrates with arms outstretched near the goal.

Cut to the sideline bench area. The scoreboard now shows OSA 2 - CEL 1 at 66:43. Players in red training tops are standing and walking near the dugout. One player with curly hair claps his hands while walking past seated staff members.

Cut back to a wide view of the pitch during active play. The clock reads 66:47. Players in red and light blue jerseys are spread across the midfield. A player in light blue receives a pass and dribbles forward towards the opponent's half.

Continuation of the wide midfield play from the previous segment. A player in light blue controls the ball near the center circle while being approached by a red-shirted defender. The play moves slightly towards the left side of the screen.

Cut to a set-piece situation near the penalty box. The clock shows 67:53. Players are clustered inside the box preparing for a corner kick or free kick. On-screen graphics display percentages (22%, 70%, 8%) and a 'CORNERS' stat box appears in the bottom right.

The set-piece is taken. The ball is crossed into the box. Players jump to head the ball. The camera remains on the wide shot of the penalty area as the play unfolds. Text overlay 'equalizer_goal_action' appears at the bottom.

uncertainties: Exact identity of players on the bench is uncertain due to distance and angle.
Specific outcome of the set-piece in the final segment is not fully visible within the provided timeframe.
